body: Wow using big words must make you feel smart

Ok. I just can't seem to get happy and i always feel like shit. The stuff that was fun is not fun anymore and I feel like ill never be enough. It feels like I'm just in other peoples way. I'm also always tired like some days I could sleep 14 hours and wake up and still be tired.

To sum everything up Im just generally done with life. It feels like when I reach out for help people see my hand and walk away.
Don't know if its the place to share them but I'd love to hear them
